title.zh: macOS 27 模拟器

description.en: Built in ~75 minutes: a log-inable macOS simulator site with cloud sync and clickable apps.
description.zh: 约 75 分钟做出可登录、带云同步与可点应用的 macOS 模拟站。

entries.author: Max Weinbach
entries.why_included: 少数能直接打开用的 live demo。

title.en: Background computer use + parallel agents roundup
title.zh: 后台计算机操控与并行智能体综述

description.en: techAU launch roundup covering async tool calling, mid-stream steering, background OS computer use (screenshots/DOM/controls), and early Blender/Unreal community demos.
description.zh: techAU 发布综述：异步工具调用、中途接管、后台 OS 计算机操控（截图/DOM/控件），以及早期 Blender/Unreal 社区演示。

entries.author: Jason Cartwright / techAU
entries.cost_note: Cites OSWorld ~40 min/task vs ~75 min prior
entries.why_included: Clear product explanation of background computer use and parallel sub-agents with linked early builds.

title.zh: GPT-6 Astra 官方发布

description.en: OpenAI’s flagship announcement positioning Astra for computer use, coding, math/science, professional work, and cybersecurity, with staged rollout and API model id gpt-6-astra.
description.zh: OpenAI 旗舰发布：定位 Astra 于计算机操控、编程、数理科学、专业工作与网络安全；分阶段上线，API 模型 id 为 gpt-6-astra。

entries.author: OpenAI
entries.cost_note: API standard $10/M input, $50/M output; Fast mode 2× price
entries.why_included: Canonical product framing and claimed capability map every gallery entry should be checked against.

title.zh: OpenAI 发布推文串

description.en: Official X announcement thread for GPT-6 Astra (status 2095595741528125780), the primary social launch artifact cited across early demos.
description.zh: GPT-6 Astra 官方 X 发布串（status 2095595741528125780），早期演示广泛引用的主社交发布物。

entries.author: @OpenAI
entries.why_included: Primary launch media many community demos remix; link resolves (HTTP 200) even when embeds vary.

title.zh: OSWorld 2.0：更快的桌面智能体

description.en: Vendor/third-party tables: Astra ~72.6% on OSWorld 2.0 at ~40 minutes/task versus Sol ~65.7% at ~75 minutes; ScreenSpot-Pro 92.7% vs 76.9%.
description.zh: 厂商/第三方表：Astra 在 OSWorld 2.0 约 72.6%、约 40 分钟/任务，对比 Sol 约 65.7%、约 75 分钟；ScreenSpot-Pro 92.7% vs 76.9%。

entries.author: OpenAI (via Vellum)
entries.cost_note: ~47% less time per OSWorld task vs Sol
entries.why_included: Quantifies the computer-use speed story that demos alone cannot prove.

title.zh: 用 Astra 做建筑可视化

description.en: OpenAI Developers writeup of designing Solace: floor plans, editable Blender geometry via bpy, lived-in props, Cycles camera tours, and interactive UE5 walkthrough with operable fixtures.
description.zh: OpenAI Developers 长文：设计 Solace——平面图、bpy 可编辑 Blender 几何、生活化道具、Cycles 镜头游、可交互 UE5 漫游与可操作装置。

entries.author: OpenAI Developers / Thomas Ricouard
entries.why_included: Long-form reproducible workflow showing Astra as a spatial design agent across Blender and Unreal.

title.zh: Blender → Unreal 房屋漫游（Dimillian）

description.en: Thomas Ricouard (@Dimillian) walks through Astra building the launch-blog house via Blender headless/Python, Cycles renders, UE5 export pipeline, and a 60 FPS walkable app.
description.zh: Thomas Ricouard（@Dimillian）演示 Astra 经 Blender headless/Python、Cycles 渲染、UE5 导出管线做出发布博客同款房屋，并做成 60 FPS 可漫游应用。

entries.author: @Dimillian (Thomas Ricouard)
entries.why_included: Concrete end-to-end 3D production pipeline (plan → Blender → UE5 → interactive app), not just a still render.

title.zh: 房屋照片 → 可编辑 Blender 重建

description.en: Tom Krcha (@tomkrcha) feeds Astra a house photo and gets a detailed Blender reconstruction with toys, appliances, and furniture, claimed tweakable and runnable at 60 FPS.
description.zh: Tom Krcha（@tomkrcha）给 Astra 一张房屋照片，得到含玩具、家电与家具的细致 Blender 重建，号称可微调并以 60 FPS 运行。

entries.author: @tomkrcha (via techAU)
entries.why_included: Image-to-editable-3D reconstruction is a distinct spatial capability beyond text-to-scene demos.

title.zh: 用 Astra 做游戏（Void Explorer）

description.en: Codex + Astra build of Void Explorer: 2,048 star systems, procedural planets, continuous space-to-ground descent in Three.js/WebGPU, plus Sunwake and Hollowflux browser games.
description.zh: Codex + Astra 打造 Void Explorer：2048 个恒星系、程序化行星、Three.js/WebGPU 连续从太空到地面降落，另有 Sunwake 与 Hollowflux 浏览器游戏。

entries.author: Thomas Ricouard
entries.why_included: Playable, inspectable multi-game build with architecture, testing harness, and Sites deploy loop.

title.zh: FrontierCode 近持平、成本更低

description.en: Latent Space AINews summarizes Cognition: on FrontierCode 1.1 Astra is within 0.4 points of Fable 5 at ~64% lower cost; Vellum notes Extended 64.5% slightly trails Fable 5’s 64.9%.
description.zh: Latent Space AINews 汇总 Cognition：FrontierCode 1.1 上 Astra 距 Fable 5 仅 0.4 分、成本约低 64%；Vellum 称 Extended 64.5% 略低于 Fable 5 的 64.9%。

entries.author: Cognition / Latent Space; cross-check Vellum
entries.cost_note: ~64% lower cost vs Fable 5 at near-parity (per @cognition summary)
entries.why_included: Mergeability-oriented coding eval showing economics, not just pass rates.

title.zh: Latent Space：不到 $6/小时的 AI 工程师

description.en: swyx/Latent Space early-access writeup after 20B+ Astra tokens: fleets of subagents, run babysitting, personal Arena clones, and framing Astra as an automated AI engineer.
description.zh: swyx/Latent Space 早鸟体验（消耗 200 亿+ Astra token）：子智能体舰队、跑任务保姆、个人 Arena 克隆，并把 Astra 框成自动化 AI 工程师。

entries.author: Latent Space
entries.cost_note: ~$6/hr at 33 tok/s and $50/M output; Ultra fleets cost much more
entries.why_included: Rare high-token practical burn report with concrete agent-orchestration patterns and cost framing.

title.zh: ARC Prize：Astra 在 ARC-AGI-3

description.en: ARC Prize reports Astra 62.7% ($26k) on Semi-Private with Standard harness and 99.9% (~$19k) with Provider Adapter; fewer actions than humans on 96% of levels; emergent symbolic DSL notes.
description.zh: ARC Prize：Standard harness 半私有集 62.7%（$26k），Provider Adapter 99.9%（约 $19k）；96% 关卡动作少于人类；并有涌现符号 DSL 笔记。

entries.author: ARC Prize
entries.cost_note: Standard max ~$26,098; Provider Adapter high ~$18,817; ~$360/game cited in related Chollet commentary
entries.why_included: Independent interactive-reasoning eval with harness caveats and action-efficiency analysis, not just a headline score.

title.zh: Epoch FrontierMath Erdős：2/68 道 Lean 验证题

description.en: Epoch AI’s Lean-verified open Erdős problem set: only Astra scored (3%), solving problems 74 and 126 within $300/72h; extra runs found 5/68 but burned >$220k compute.
description.zh: Epoch AI 的 Lean 验证开放 Erdős 题集：仅 Astra 得分（3%），在 $300/72 小时内解出第 74、126 题；额外跑分达 5/68，但算力花费超过 $22 万。

entries.author: Epoch AI (Greg Burnham, Tom Adamczewski)
entries.cost_note: Benchmark: $218–$247 for the two solves; extra attempts >$220,000 total
entries.why_included: Transparent open-problem math eval with Lean verification and published budgets—rare substance over vibes.

title.zh: FrontierMath Tier 4 近饱和声称

description.en: OpenAI reports Astra at 97.6% on FrontierMath Tier 4 (v2) vs Sol ~83% and Fable 5.1 87.8%; paired with claims of helping solve long-standing open math problems.
description.zh: OpenAI 称 Astra 在 FrontierMath Tier 4（v2）达 97.6%，对比 Sol 约 83%、Fable 5.1 的 87.8%；并称有助于攻克长期未解数学题。

entries.author: OpenAI (via Vellum); Epoch notes funding caveats
entries.cost_note: Vellum notes Epoch: OpenAI funded FrontierMath and has exclusive access to part of it
entries.why_included: Headline math saturation number with an important independence caveat for gallery honesty.

title.zh: ExploitBench 满分与 Critical 网络安全档

description.en: Astra is OpenAI’s first Critical cybersecurity model; ExploitBench 100% (vs Sol 78.5%); advanced cyber gated via Daybreak; evals found zero-days later disclosed to maintainers.
description.zh: Astra 是 OpenAI 首个 Critical 网络安全模型；ExploitBench 100%（Sol 78.5%）；高级网络能力经 Daybreak 门控；评测中发现的零日漏洞已向维护者披露。

entries.author: eesel AI / OpenAI Preparedness framing
entries.why_included: Defines the gated cyber story that separates Astra from prior OpenAI releases.

title.zh: SRE-Bench 二进制逆向工程

description.en: OpenAI reports Astra solves 88.0% of SRE-Bench tasks in one attempt and 99.2% within four (vs Sol 55.9%/68.7%), measuring reverse engineering of binaries without source.
description.zh: OpenAI 称 Astra 在 SRE-Bench 单次尝试解出 88.0%、四次内 99.2%（Sol 为 55.9%/68.7%），衡量无源码二进制逆向能力。

entries.author: OpenAI (via Vellum summary)
entries.cost_note: Latent Space also notes ValsAI commentary on pass@4 / custom harness caveats
entries.why_included: Concrete cyber capability number with attempt protocol; gallery-worthy because it is capability + harness-caveat.

title.zh: AutomationBench 专业办公跃升

description.en: OpenAI’s AutomationBench shows Astra 41.4% vs Fable 5.1 31.4% and Sol 18.1% on template-driven professional automation (slides/spreadsheets/analyses).
description.zh: OpenAI 的 AutomationBench 显示：模板驱动的专业自动化（幻灯片/表格/分析）上 Astra 41.4%，对比 Fable 5.1 的 31.4% 与 Sol 的 18.1%。

entries.author: OpenAI (via Vellum)
entries.why_included: Largest published professional-work delta; anchors docs/office category with numbers.

title.zh: Perplexity WANDR 研究智能体夺冠

description.en: Perplexity reports Astra tops WANDR at score 0.682 and $11.98/task — 13.5% above Fable 5.1 at 6.1% lower cost (per Latent Space AINews aggregation of @perplexity_ai).
description.zh: Perplexity 称 Astra 在 WANDR 以 0.682 分、$11.98/任务居首——比 Fable 5.1 高 13.5%，成本低 6.1%（据 Latent Space AINews 汇总 @perplexity_ai）。

entries.author: Perplexity (@perplexity_ai) via Latent Space
entries.why_included: Independent research-workflow leaderboard with explicit cost-per-task — gallery gold for knowledge work.

title.en: Vellum: every published Astra benchmark table
title.zh: Vellum：Astra 已公开基准表全解析

description.en: Side-by-side walkthrough of OpenAI’s computer-use, professional, coding, academic, science, cyber, and alignment tables, including AutomationBench 41.4% and contested coding rows.
description.zh: 并排解读 OpenAI 计算机操控、专业工作、编程、学术、科学、网络安全与对齐各表，含 AutomationBench 41.4% 及有争议的编程行。

entries.author: Nicolas Zeeb / Vellum
entries.cost_note: Notes $10/$50 vs Sol $4/$20 and that efficiency offset is still sparsely evidenced
entries.why_included: Best organized third-party unpack of vendor tables, including losses (HLE tools) and professional-work gains.

title.en: Artificial Analysis: Coding vs Intelligence split
title.zh: Artificial Analysis：编程与智能指数分野

description.en: Independent lab finds Coding Agent Index 67 (≈Fable 5, cheaper/task) but Intelligence Index flat at 61 vs Sol; ~3× coding token efficiency; Intelligence Index ~75% more expensive per task after 2.5× price hike.
description.zh: 独立实验室：Coding Agent Index 67（约平 Fable 5、更便宜/任务），但 Intelligence Index 相对 Sol 仍为 61；编程 token 效率约 3×；涨价 2.5× 后 Intelligence 每任务约贵 75%。

entries.author: Artificial Analysis
entries.cost_note: Price $10/$50 (2.5× Sol); coding Pareto cost leader; intelligence ~75% costlier/task at max
entries.why_included: Essential non-cheerleading cost/perf reality check that separates coding-agent wins from general-intelligence hype.

title.en: eesel: what it costs and the catch
title.zh: eesel：成本与代价

description.en: Practitioner writeup contrasting agentic/cyber jumps with flat AA Intelligence Index, $10/$50 pricing, Daybreak gating, and OpenAI’s admission that monitorability decreased vs Sol.
description.zh: 实践向长文：对照智能体/网络安全跃升与 AA Intelligence Index 持平、$10/$50 定价、Daybreak 门控，以及 OpenAI 承认相对 Sol 可监控性下降。

entries.author: Kurnia Kharisma Agung Samiadjie / eesel
entries.why_included: Honest cost + safety catch piece suitable as a skeptical gallery card, not cheerleading.

title.en: HN thread on AA 'major gains' title
title.zh: HN 讨论 AA「重大提升」标题

description.en: Hacker News discussion of Artificial Analysis results; top critique notes Intelligence Index 61→61 despite 'major gains' framing, plus broader benchmark-trust debate.
description.zh: Hacker News 讨论 Artificial Analysis 结果；置顶批评指出 Intelligence Index 仍为 61→61，却用「重大提升」包装，并延伸基准可信度争论。

entries.author: HN / NiekvdMaas et al.
entries.cost_note: Commenters note cost-per-task Pareto may be the real gain
entries.why_included: Documented skeptical community read that keeps the gallery honest about marketing vs charts.

title.en: Latent Space AINews Astra launch digest
title.zh: Latent Space AINews：Astra 发布精粹

description.en: Dense day-after digest aggregating official claims, Artificial Analysis/ARC/Epoch/Perplexity/Cognition/Vals numbers, safety/monitorability debate, and rollout friction.
description.zh: 发布次日高密度精粹：汇总官方主张，Artificial Analysis/ARC/Epoch/Perplexity/Cognition/Vals 数据，安全/可监控性争论与上线摩擦。

entries.author: Latent Space
entries.cost_note: Summarizes $10/$50 pricing and per-task vs per-token debate
entries.why_included: Best single secondary index of verified third-party numbers and skeptical takes for curators.

title.en: HN: OpenAI begins rolling out GPT-6 Astra
title.zh: HN：OpenAI 开始推送 GPT-6 Astra

description.en: Hacker News discussion of CNBC rollout coverage, including Brockman’s AGI-era comments, price-per-task framing, and cyber-gated staged release.
description.zh: Hacker News 讨论 CNBC 推送报道，含 Brockman 的 AGI 时代评论、按任务计价框架，以及网络安全门控的分阶段发布。

entries.author: Hacker News
entries.cost_note: Quotes Brockman: price per task is what matters
entries.why_included: Public skeptical/governance thread pairing capability claims with rollout and cyber caution.

title.zh: Transformer：neuralese 与思维链可监控性担忧

description.en: Explainer on recurrent-depth/'neuralese' concerns around Astra, Ryan Greenblatt’s warning, and Jakub Pachocki’s reply that computation depth stays within ~2× of GPT-4.
description.zh: 解读围绕 Astra 的循环深度/「neuralese」担忧、Ryan Greenblatt 的警告，以及 Jakub Pachocki 回应称计算深度仍约在 GPT-4 的 2× 以内。

entries.author: Transformer News
entries.why_included: Best accessible critical safety card on why monitorability, not just capability, belongs in an Astra gallery.
